dz: 教皇克莱门特五世对威尼斯实施逐出教会和禁令，并全面禁止与威尼斯的所有商业往来，威尼斯占领了罗马教皇的领地费拉拉。
de: Pope Clement V imposes excommunication and interdiction on Venice, and a general prohibition of all commercial intercourse with Venice, which had seized Ferrara, a papal fiefdom.

t: 亨利七世被教宗克莱门特五世所承认为罗马人的国王(神圣罗马皇帝).
te: Henry VII is recognized King of the Romans (Holy Roman Emperor) by Pope Clement V.
dz: 亨利七世被教宗克莱门特五世所承认为罗马人的国王(神圣罗马皇帝).
de: Henry VII is recognized King of the Romans (Holy Roman Emperor) by Pope Clement V.

dz: 第一次对直布罗陀的包围是在西班牙的"重新征服"(Reconquista)的背景下进行的,使卡斯蒂利亚王国的势力与格拉纳达酋长国对抗并导致卡斯蒂利亚人的胜利.
de: The first siege of Gibraltar takes place in the context of the Spanish Reconquista, pitting the forces of the Kingdom of Castile against the Emirate of Granada and resulting in a Castilian victory.
